objective: 建立字段主列表、业务表单字段集合、表单/列表/分步视图和页面 Block 的平台底层配置能力，同时保持业务模块独立维护。
scope: frontend metadata contracts and designer foundation
decisions: Keep business module routes, menus, APIs and services module-owned.
Treat current form field definitions as the business field collection and add view references without breaking V32.
Require list fields to reference enabled form-available fields.
Use whitelisted component and block keys; never load arbitrary component paths from the database.
invariants: Existing form metadata APIs remain readable and writable.
Tenant and RBAC checks remain server-side.
No generic cross-business CRUD or arbitrary scripts are introduced.

unknowns.question: Which concrete business module will be used for end-to-end validation?

approval.evidence: User explicitly requested implementation of the revised field-governed designer architecture.
